subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Trade works only when people believe the measure is fair.”?
options: Without them, thoughts cannot travel far.
Without trust, even exact numbers lose power.
Good testing measures learning without ignoring dignity.
People need the power to keep it working.

本文可直接核對「Trade works only when people believe the measure is fair. Without trust, even exact numbers lose power.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Trade works only when people believe the measure is fair. Without trust, even exact numbers lose power.」，答案為「Without trust, even exact numbers lose power.」。
